title: SpaceDiffusion: Over-the-Orbit Diffusion for Space Generate-and-Forward Communications
abstract: arXiv:2609.20899v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Satellite communications are an essential component of sixth-generation (6G) mobile networks, which provide ubiquitous connectivity for global services. However, the satellite uplink remains a critical bottleneck for ground devices: their limited transmit power and antenna apertures result in low data rates and high packet errors. To overcome this bottleneck, this paper advocates a novel relaying paradigm termed generate-and-forward (GF) communications, where satellites exploit on-orbit generative artificial intelligence (AI) to robustly reconstruct corrupted data prior to forwarding. Specifically, we propose SpaceDiffusion, an over-the-orbit diffusion framework for satellite-assisted image transmission. translated_title: SpaceDiffusion：面向空间“生成-转发”通信的在轨扩散框架
translated_abstract: 卫星通信是第六代（6G）移动网络的重要组成部分，可为全球服务提供泛在连接。然而，卫星上行链路仍然是地面设备的关键瓶颈：其有限的发射功率和天线孔径导致了低数据速率和高丢包率。为克服这一瓶颈，本文提出了一种新颖的中继范式，称为“生成-转发”通信，即卫星利用在轨生成式人工智能（AI）在转发之前稳健地重建受损数据。具体而言，我们提出了SpaceDiffusion，一个面向卫星辅助图像传输的在轨扩散框架。该框架的核心是一种信道失真感知的扩散理论，其构建思路如下：通过将压缩和丢失图像令牌的恢复问题表述为一个逆问题，该理论引入了信道（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了SpaceDiffusion——一种面向卫星图像传输的在轨扩散框架，通过引入“生成-转发”通信范式，让卫星利用在轨生成式AI在转发前重建受损数据，从而突破地面设备上行链路的功率与速率瓶颈。
en_tdlr: SpaceDiffusion proposes an over-the-orbit diffusion framework for satellite-assisted image transmission, introducing a novel generate-and-forward relaying paradigm where satellites use on-orbit generative AI to reconstruct corrupted data before forwarding, thus overcoming the uplink bottleneck of power-limited ground devices.
